content.json:
# Cloud Center of Excellence
One scorecard for the team that sets cloud standards: governance and tagging, landing zone placement, security posture and privileged access, savings and idle resources, monitoring, patching and retirements, by subscription. Read from Azure Resource Graph: no workspace needed. You need **Reader** across the subscriptions (at the tenant root management group to see everything).

parameters.name: Subscription
parameters.label: Subscriptions
parameters.query:
summarize by subscriptionId
| project value = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId), label = subscriptionId

parameters.name: RequiredTags
parameters.label: Required tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated tag names every resource should carry, as your tagging policy sets out. Compared without case.

parameters.name: OwnerTag
parameters.label: Owner tag
parameters.description: The tag on a subscription that names its owner, shown beside each subscription.

parameters.name: ApprovedRegions
parameters.label: Approved regions
parameters.description: Optional. Comma-separated Azure region names (for example uksouth,ukwest). Resources elsewhere are counted on the Scorecard and listed on Governance & tagging.

content.query:
policyresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| summarize Total = dcount(tostring(properties.resourceId)),
    Bad = dcountif(tostring(properties.resourceId), tostring(properties.complianceState) =~ 'NonCompliant')
| project Signal = 'Policy compliance',
    Value = iff(Total == 0, real(null), round(100.0 * (Total - Bad) / Total, 1)),
    Detail = strcat(Bad, ' non-compliant resources'),
    State = case(Total == 0, 'Unknown', Bad == 0, 'Available', 'Degraded')

resources
| where type !in~ ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/extensions', 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions', 'microsoft.network/networkwatchers', 'microsoft.network/networkwatchers/flowlogs', 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/smartdetectoralertrules', 'microsoft.compute/restorepointcollections')
| extend tagText = tolower(tostring(tags)), required = split(tolower('{RequiredTags}'), ',')
| mv-expand tag = required
| extend tag = trim(' ', tostring(tag))
| where isnotempty(tag)
| extend HasTag = tagText contains strcat('"', tag, '":')
| summarize Missing = make_set_if(tag, not(HasTag)) by id, type, subscriptionId, resourceGroup
| summarize Total = count(), Full = countif(array_length(Missing) == 0)
| project Signal = 'Tag coverage', Value = iff(Total == 0, real(null), round(100.0 * Full / Total, 1)),
    Detail = strcat(Total - Full, ' resources missing a required tag'),
    State = case(Total == 0, 'Unknown', Full == Total, 'Available', Full >= 0.8 * Total, 'Degraded', 'Unavailable')

resourcecontainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| extend chain = properties.managementGroupAncestorsChain
| project subscriptionId, Subscription = name, SubState = tostring(properties.state),
    ParentMG = iff(array_length(chain) > 0, tostring(chain[0].displayName), '(none)'),
    Depth = coalesce(array_length(chain), 0),
    Offer = tostring(split(tostring(properties.subscriptionPolicies.quotaId), '_')[0]),
    Owner = extract(@'(?i)"{OwnerTag}":"([^"]*)"', 1, tostring(tags))
| extend Placement = case(Depth == 0, 'No management group', Depth == 1, 'Directly under tenant root', 'In a management group')
| summarize Total = count(), Outside = countif(Placement != 'In a management group')
| project Signal = 'Subscriptions at the tenant root', Value = Outside, Detail = strcat('of ', Total, ' subscriptions'),
    State = iff(Outside > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')

resources
| where isnotempty(location) and location !~ 'global'
| summarize Resources = count() by location = tolower(location), subscriptionId
| extend approved = split(tolower('{ApprovedRegions}'), ',')
| mv-expand a = approved
| extend a = trim(' ', tostring(a))
| summarize Approved = countif(a == location), Listed = countif(isnotempty(a)) by location, subscriptionId, Resources
| where Listed > 0 and Approved == 0
| summarize Resources = sum(Resources), Regions = dcount(location)
| project Signal = 'Resources outside approved regions', Value = coalesce(Resources, 0),
    Detail = strcat('in ', coalesce(Regions, 0), ' regions'), State = iff(coalesce(Resources, 0) > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')

securityresources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.security/securescores', 'microsoft.security/locations/alerts')
| extend isScore = type =~ 'microsoft.security/securescores',
    isActiveAlert = type =~ 'microsoft.security/locations/alerts' and tostring(properties.Status) =~ 'Active'
| summarize Score = avgif(toreal(properties.score.percentage), isScore), Subs = countif(isScore),
    Alerts = countif(isActiveAlert), High = countif(isActiveAlert and tostring(properties.Severity) =~ 'High')
| project Signal = 'Defender for Cloud',
    Value = iff(Subs == 0, real(null), round(Score * 100, 0)),
    Detail = strcat('secure score · ', Alerts, ' alerts (', High, ' high)'),
    State = case(High > 0, 'Unavailable', Subs == 0, 'Unknown', Score < 0.5, 'Unavailable', Score < 0.8 or Alerts > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')

authorizationresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roleassignments'
| extend roleId = tolower(tostring(split(tostring(properties.roleDefinitionId), '/')[-1])),
    scope = tolower(tostring(properties.scope))
| where roleId in ('8e3af657-a8ff-443c-a75c-2fe8c4bcb635', '18d7d88d-d35e-4fb5-a5c3-7773c20a72d9', 'f58310d9-a9f6-439a-9e8d-f62e7b41a168')
| extend Role = case(roleId startswith '8e3af657', 'Owner', roleId startswith '18d7d88d', 'User Access Administrator',
        'RBAC Administrator'),
    ScopeLevel = case(scope == '/', 'Tenant root', scope startswith '/providers/microsoft.management/managementgroups/', 'Management group',
        array_length(split(scope, '/')) == 3, 'Subscription', array_length(split(scope, '/')) == 5, 'Resource group', 'Resource')
| summarize by scope, ScopeLevel, Role, principalType = tostring(properties.principalType), principalId = tostring(properties.principalId)
| where ScopeLevel in ('Tenant root', 'Management group', 'Subscription')
| summarize Direct = countif(principalType =~ 'User'), Total = count()
| project Signal = 'Privileged roles held by users directly', Value = Direct,
    Detail = strcat('of ', Total, ' at subscription scope or above'), State = iff(Direct > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')

advisorresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| extend Category = tostring(properties.category)
| extend Pillar = case(Category =~ 'HighAvailability', 'Reliability', Category =~ 'Cost', 'Cost Optimization',
        Category =~ 'OperationalExcellence', 'Operational Excellence', Category =~ 'Performance', 'Performance Efficiency',
        Category),
    Impact = tostring(properties.impact),
    Problem = tostring(properties.shortDescription.problem),
    Solution = tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution),
    RecType = tostring(properties.recommendationTypeId),
    rid = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId)),
    Savings = coalesce(todouble(properties.extendedProperties.annualSavingsAmount),
        12 * todouble(properties.extendedProperties.savingsAmount)),
    Currency = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.savingsCurrency)
| where Pillar == 'Cost Optimization'
| summarize Savings = sum(Savings), Recs = count(), Currency = take_anyif(Currency, isnotempty(Currency))
| project Signal = 'Advisor savings a year', Value = round(coalesce(Savings, 0.0), 0),
    Detail = strcat(coalesce(Currency, ''), ' · ', Recs, ' recommendations'), State = iff(Recs > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')

resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.compute/disks', 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', 'microsoft.network/natgateways', 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', 'microsoft.web/serverfarms')

| extend Waste = case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and (tostring(properties.diskState) =~ 'Unattached' and isempty(managedBy)), 'Unattached disk',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' and (isempty(tostring(properties.ipConfiguration.id)) and isempty(tostring(properties.natGateway.id))), 'Unused public IP',
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.code) =~ 'PowerState/stopped'), 'VM stopped but not deallocated',
    type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and (toint(properties.numberOfSites) == 0 and tolower(tostring(sku.tier)) !in ('free', 'shared', 'dynamic')), 'App Service plan with no apps',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Standard' and coalesce(array_length(properties.backendAddressPools), 0) == 0), 'Load balancer with no backend pools',
    type =~ 'microsoft.network/natgateways' and (coalesce(array_length(properties.subnets), 0) == 0), 'NAT gateway on no subnet',
    type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots' and (todatetime(properties.timeCreated) < ago(90d)), 'Snapshot older than 90 days',
    '')
| where isnotempty(Waste)
| extend Detail = case(Waste == 'Unattached disk', strcat(tostring(properties.diskSizeGB), ' GB ', tostring(sku.name)), Waste == 'Unused public IP', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' ', tostring(properties.ipAddress)), Waste == 'VM stopped but not deallocated', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), Waste == 'App Service plan with no apps', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' x', tostring(sku.capacity)), Waste == 'Load balancer with no backend pools', tostring(sku.name), Waste == 'NAT gateway on no subnet', tostring(sku.name), Waste == 'Snapshot older than 90 days', strcat(tostring(properties.diskSizeGB), ' GB, taken ', format_datetime(todatetime(properties.timeCreated), 'yyyy-MM-dd')), ''),
    Fix = case(Waste == 'Unattached disk', 'Snapshot it if it may be needed again, then delete it', Waste == 'Unused public IP', 'Delete it, unless the address is reserved for a planned service', Waste == 'VM stopped but not deallocated', 'Stop it from the portal or with deallocate: a VM shut down from inside is still billed for compute', Waste == 'App Service plan with no apps', 'Delete the plan: it is billed per instance whether or not it hosts apps', Waste == 'Load balancer with no backend pools', 'Delete it: Standard load balancers are billed per rule', Waste == 'NAT gateway on no subnet', 'Delete it, or attach it to the subnets that need outbound access', Waste == 'Snapshot older than 90 days', 'Delete it if it is not part of a retention plan; use Azure Backup for long-term copies', '')
| project id, Waste, Detail, Fix, subscriptionId, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, Location = location
| summarize Resources = count(), Kinds = dcount(Waste)
| project Signal = 'Idle resources', Value = Resources, Detail = strcat(Kinds, ' kinds · see Cost'),
    State = iff(Resources > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')

advisorresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| where tostring(properties.impact) =~ 'High'
| summarize Problems = dcount(tostring(properties.shortDescription.problem)), Total = count(),
    Reliability = countif(tostring(properties.category) =~ 'HighAvailability')
| project Signal = 'Advisor high-impact issues', Value = Problems,
    Detail = strcat(Total, ' affected resources (', Reliability, ' reliability)'),
    State = case(Reliability > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')

resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines')

| project id = tolower(id), subscriptionId, Kind = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines', 'Arc server', 'VM'),
    OS = coalesce(tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType), tostring(properties.osType)),
    Power = tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.displayStatus), ResourceGroup = resourceGroup
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type in~ ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/extensions', 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions')
    | extend ext = tostring(properties.type)
    | where ext in~ ('AzureMonitorWindowsAgent', 'AzureMonitorLinuxAgent', 'MicrosoftMonitoringAgent', 'OmsAgentForLinux')
    | summarize Ama = countif(ext startswith 'AzureMonitor'), Legacy = countif(not(ext startswith 'AzureMonitor'))
        by id = tostring(split(tolower(id), '/extensions/')[0])
  ) on id
| extend Agent = case(Ama > 0 and Legacy > 0, 'Azure Monitor Agent and legacy agent', Ama > 0, 'Azure Monitor Agent',
    Legacy > 0, 'Legacy agent only', 'No agent')
| project-away id1
| summarize Total = count(), Gaps = countif(Agent in ('Legacy agent only', 'No agent')),
    Legacy = countif(Agent == 'Legacy agent only')
| project Signal = 'Machines without Azure Monitor Agent', Value = Gaps,
    Detail = strcat('of ', Total, ' · ', Legacy, ' on the legacy agent'),
    State = case(Total == 0, 'Unknown', Gaps > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')

advisorresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| extend Category = tostring(properties.category)
| extend Pillar = case(Category =~ 'HighAvailability', 'Reliability', Category =~ 'Cost', 'Cost Optimization',
        Category =~ 'OperationalExcellence', 'Operational Excellence', Category =~ 'Performance', 'Performance Efficiency',
        Category),
    Impact = tostring(properties.impact),
    Problem = tostring(properties.shortDescription.problem),
    Solution = tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution),
    RecType = tostring(properties.recommendationTypeId),
    rid = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId)),
    Savings = coalesce(todouble(properties.extendedProperties.annualSavingsAmount),
        12 * todouble(properties.extendedProperties.savingsAmount)),
    Currency = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.savingsCurrency)
| where tostring(properties.extendedProperties.recommendationSubCategory) =~ 'ServiceUpgradeAndRetirement'
| extend Retires = todatetime(properties.extendedProperties.retirementDate),
    Retiring = coalesce(tostring(properties.extendedProperties.retirementFeatureName), Problem)
| where Retires < now() + 180d
| summarize Features = dcount(Retiring), Resources = dcount(rid)
| project Signal = 'Retiring within 180 days', Value = Features, Detail = strcat(Resources, ' resources affected'),
    State = iff(Features > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')

content.json:
**How to read this.** Each tile is one measure the CCoE owns; a green tick means nothing needs action, amber means
some subscriptions are behind. *Policy compliance* is the share of evaluated resources with no failing policy (as in
the Azure portal). *Tag coverage* counts resources that carry every tag in **Required tags**, ignoring the
platform's own types that nobody tags (extensions, Network Watcher). *Privileged roles* are Owner, User Access
Administrator and RBAC Administrator assigned to a user rather than a group. *Idle resources* are unattached disks,
unused public IPs, stopped but billed VMs, empty App Service plans, unused load balancers and NAT gateways, and old
snapshots. *Advisor savings* is Azure Advisor's own estimate, a year. Advisor high-impact issues and the Defender for
Cloud secure score are the same figures as on the Platform health overview.

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| extend chain = properties.managementGroupAncestorsChain
| project subscriptionId, Subscription = name, SubState = tostring(properties.state),
    ParentMG = iff(array_length(chain) > 0, tostring(chain[0].displayName), '(none)'),
    Depth = coalesce(array_length(chain), 0),
    Offer = tostring(split(tostring(properties.subscriptionPolicies.quotaId), '_')[0]),
    Owner = extract(@'(?i)"{OwnerTag}":"([^"]*)"', 1, tostring(tags))
| extend Placement = case(Depth == 0, 'No management group', Depth == 1, 'Directly under tenant root', 'In a management group')
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type !in~ ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/extensions', 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions', 'microsoft.network/networkwatchers', 'microsoft.network/networkwatchers/flowlogs', 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/smartdetectoralertrules', 'microsoft.compute/restorepointcollections')
    | extend tagText = tolower(tostring(tags)), required = split(tolower('{RequiredTags}'), ',')
    | mv-expand tag = required
    | extend tag = trim(' ', tostring(tag))
    | where isnotempty(tag)
    | extend HasTag = tagText contains strcat('"', tag, '":')
    | summarize Missing = make_set_if(tag, not(HasTag)) by id, type, subscriptionId, resourceGroup
    | summarize Resources = count(), Tagged = countif(array_length(Missing) == 0) by subscriptionId
  ) on subscriptionId
| join kind=leftouter (
    policyresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
    | summarize Evaluated = dcount(tostring(properties.resourceId)),
        NonCompliant = dcountif(tostring(properties.resourceId), tostring(properties.complianceState) =~ 'NonCompliant')
        by subscriptionId
  ) on subscriptionId
| join kind=leftouter (
    securityresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.security/securescores'
    | project subscriptionId, SecureScorePct = round(100 * toreal(properties.score.percentage), 0)
  ) on subscriptionId
| project Subscription, ParentMG, Placement, Owner, Resources = coalesce(Resources, 0),
    TagPct = iff(Resources > 0, round(100.0 * Tagged / Resources, 0), real(null)),
    PolicyPct = iff(Evaluated > 0, round(100.0 * (Evaluated - NonCompliant) / Evaluated, 0), real(null)),
    SecureScorePct, subscriptionId
| order by PolicyPct asc
content.title: Scorecard by subscription
content.noDataMessage: No subscriptions selected.

content.json: Where subscriptions sit in the management group hierarchy, and how the estate is growing. In an Azure landing zone every subscription belongs under a landing zone, platform, sandbox or decommissioned management group; one *directly under the tenant root* gets none of the policies or access set on those groups.

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| extend chain = properties.managementGroupAncestorsChain
| project subscriptionId, Subscription = name, SubState = tostring(properties.state),
    ParentMG = iff(array_length(chain) > 0, tostring(chain[0].displayName), '(none)'),
    Depth = coalesce(array_length(chain), 0),
    Offer = tostring(split(tostring(properties.subscriptionPolicies.quotaId), '_')[0]),
    Owner = extract(@'(?i)"{OwnerTag}":"([^"]*)"', 1, tostring(tags))
| extend Placement = case(Depth == 0, 'No management group', Depth == 1, 'Directly under tenant root', 'In a management group')
| summarize Subscriptions = count() by ParentMG
| order by Subscriptions desc
content.title: Subscriptions by parent management group

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| extend chain = properties.managementGroupAncestorsChain
| project subscriptionId, Subscription = name, SubState = tostring(properties.state),
    ParentMG = iff(array_length(chain) > 0, tostring(chain[0].displayName), '(none)'),
    Depth = coalesce(array_length(chain), 0),
    Offer = tostring(split(tostring(properties.subscriptionPolicies.quotaId), '_')[0]),

  ) on subscriptionId

| extend Time = todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp), ChangeType = tostring(properties.changeType)

| order by Day asc

content.json: Resource Graph keeps 14 days of change history, so growth is shown for that window only. For a resource-by-resource view of the changes, use the **What changed?** workbook.
Policy compliance and tagging by subscription. For the detail behind a low score (which policies fail, exemptions, regulatory initiatives) open the **Azure Policy compliance** workbook.

content.query:
policyresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| summarize Evaluated = dcount(tostring(properties.resourceId)),
    NonCompliant = dcountif(tostring(properties.resourceId), tostring(properties.complianceState) =~ 'NonCompliant'),
    FailingPolicies = dcountif(tostring(properties.policyDefinitionId), tostring(properties.complianceState) =~ 'NonCompliant')
    by subscriptionId
| join kind=inner (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | extend chain = properties.managementGroupAncestorsChain
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name, SubState = tostring(properties.state),
        ParentMG = iff(array_length(chain) > 0, tostring(chain[0].displayName), '(none)'),
        Depth = coalesce(array_length(chain), 0),
        Offer = tostring(split(tostring(properties.subscriptionPolicies.quotaId), '_')[0]),
        Owner = extract(@'(?i)"{OwnerTag}":"([^"]*)"', 1, tostring(tags))
    | extend Placement = case(Depth == 0, 'No management group', Depth == 1, 'Directly under tenant root', 'In a management group')
  ) on subscriptionId
| project Subscription, ParentMG, Owner, Evaluated, NonCompliant, FailingPolicies,
    CompliancePct = round(100.0 * (Evaluated - NonCompliant) / Evaluated, 1)
| order by CompliancePct asc
content.title: Azure Policy compliance by subscription
content.noDataMessage: No policy evaluation results in the selected subscriptions.

content.json:
### Tagging
Measured against **Required tags** at the top. Tags inherited from a resource group by policy (*Inherit a tag from the resource group*) are written to the resource and count; tags only on the resource group do not.

content.query:
resources
| where type !in~ ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/extensions', 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions', 'microsoft.network/networkwatchers', 'microsoft.network/networkwatchers/flowlogs', 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/smartdetectoralertrules', 'microsoft.compute/restorepointcollections')
| extend tagText = tolower(tostring(tags)), required = split(tolower('{RequiredTags}'), ',')
| mv-expand tag = required
| extend tag = trim(' ', tostring(tag))
| where isnotempty(tag)
| extend HasTag = tagText contains strcat('"', tag, '":')
| summarize Resources = count(), Tagged = countif(HasTag) by Tag = tag
| extend CoveragePct = round(100.0 * Tagged / Resources, 1)
| project Tag, CoveragePct, Tagged, Missing = Resources - Tagged
| order by CoveragePct asc
content.title: Coverage by tag
content.noDataMessage: Set Required tags at the top.

| extend tagText = tolower(tostring(tags)), required = split(tolower('{RequiredTags}'), ',')

| extend HasTag = tagText contains strcat('"', tag, '":')
| summarize Missing = make_set_if(tag, not(HasTag)) by id, type, subscriptionId, resourceGroup

| join kind=leftouter (

    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name
  ) on subscriptionId
| project Subscription = coalesce(Subscription, subscriptionId), CoveragePct = round(100.0 * Tagged / Resources, 1),
    Untagged = Resources - Tagged, Resources
| order by CoveragePct asc

content.query:
resourcechanges
| extend ChangeType = tostring(properties.changeType), Client = tostring(properties.changeAttributes.clientType)
| where ChangeType != 'Update' or tostring(properties.changes) contains '"changeCategory":"User"'
| extend Client = iff(isempty(Client) or Client =~ 'Unspecified', '(not recorded)', Client)
| summarize Changes = count() by Client
| top 8 by Changes desc
content.title: Changes by tool (last 14 days)
content.noDataMessage: No changes recorded in the last 14 days.

content.query:
resourcechanges
| extend ChangeType = tostring(properties.changeType), Client = tostring(properties.changeAttributes.clientType)
| where ChangeType != 'Update' or tostring(properties.changes) contains '"changeCategory":"User"'
| extend Client = iff(isempty(Client) or Client =~ 'Unspecified', '(not recorded)', Client)
| summarize Changes = count(), Portal = countif(Client has 'portal') by subscriptionId

| join kind=leftouter (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name
  ) on subscriptionId
| project Subscription = coalesce(Subscription, subscriptionId), PortalPct = round(100.0 * Portal / Changes, 0), Portal, Changes
| order by PortalPct desc
content.title: Changes made in the Azure portal, by subscription (last 14 days)
content.noDataMessage: No changes recorded in the last 14 days.

content.query:
advisorresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| extend Category = tostring(properties.category)
| extend Pillar = case(Category =~ 'HighAvailability', 'Reliability', Category =~ 'Cost', 'Cost Optimization',
        Category =~ 'OperationalExcellence', 'Operational Excellence', Category =~ 'Performance', 'Performance Efficiency',
        Category),
    Impact = tostring(properties.impact),
    Problem = tostring(properties.shortDescription.problem),
    Solution = tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution),
    RecType = tostring(properties.recommendationTypeId),
    rid = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId)),
    Savings = coalesce(todouble(properties.extendedProperties.annualSavingsAmount),
        12 * todouble(properties.extendedProperties.savingsAmount)),
    Currency = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.savingsCurrency)
| where tostring(properties.extendedProperties.recommendationSubCategory) =~ 'ServiceUpgradeAndRetirement'
| extend Retires = todatetime(properties.extendedProperties.retirementDate),
    Retiring = coalesce(tostring(properties.extendedProperties.retirementFeatureName), Problem)
| where Retires < now() + 180d
| summarize Resources = dcount(rid), Subscriptions = dcount(subscriptionId) by Retiring, Retires, Action = Solution
| project Retiring, RetirementDate = Retires, DaysLeft = datetime_diff('day', Retires, now()), Resources, Subscriptions, Action
| order by RetirementDate asc
content.title: Azure retirements within 180 days (Azure Advisor)
content.noDataMessage: Advisor reports no retirements in the next 180 days.

content.query:
healthresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/availabilitystatuses'
| extend State = tostring(properties.availabilityState)
| where State in~ ('Unavailable', 'Degraded')
| project id = tostring(split(tolower(id), '/providers/microsoft.resourcehealth/')[0]), State,
    Reason = tostring(properties.reasonType), Summary = tostring(properties.summary),
    Since = todatetime(coalesce(tostring(properties.occurredTime), tostring(properties.occuredTime))), subscriptionId

| join kind=leftouter (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name
  ) on subscriptionId
| project id, State, Reason, Since, Summary, Subscription = coalesce(Subscription, subscriptionId)
| order by case(State =~ 'Unavailable', 0, 1) asc, Since asc
content.title: Resources currently unavailable or degraded (Resource Health)
content.noDataMessage: Resource Health reports nothing unavailable or degraded.
